title: DocDancer: Towards Agentic Document-Grounded Information Seeking
text: for LongDocURL and MMdocRAG, while for DUDE and CUAD, this limit is set to 15. We compare DocDancer against a comprehensive set of baselines categorized into four groups: Naive VLM Baselines. These methods evaluate the native long-context understanding capabilities of advanced VLMs. We directly feed PDF pages converted to images (144 DPI) into the models without external parsing or retrieval. Following the settings in MMLongBench-Doc Ma et al. ( 2024 ) , we report GPT-4o 4 4 4 https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-4o and Gemini-2.5-Pro 5 5 5 https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models?#gemini-2.5-pro . OCR-based Baselines. These baselines treat the task as text-only QA by first extracting content using OCR engines. We pair Tesseract Smith ( 2007 ) and PyMuPDF (fitz) 6 6 6 https://pymupdf.readthedocs.io/ with LLMs including GPT-4 , GPT-4o , and Gemini-2.0-Flash . RAG-based Baselines. We consider both visual and hybrid retrieval strategies: Visual Retrieval: VisRAG Yu et al. ( 2024 ) and ColPali Faysse et al. ( 2024 ) retrieve relevant page or patch-level visual evidence based on vision-centric embeddings, utilizing GPT-4o for response generation. Hybrid Retrieval: M3DocRAG Cho et al. ( 2025 ) performs joint retrieval using a multimodal retriever with Qwen2-VL-7B . RAGAnything Guo et al. ( 2025b ) structures multimodal content as knowledge entities for cross-modal retrieval, using GPT-4o-mini as the backbone. Prompt-based Agentic Baselines. We include state-of-the-art agent frameworks designed for document understanding: Doc-React Wu et al.
